h: Up and down the High Road
p: Tottenham High Road is the long, busy main road through this part of north London, and this branch sits on the shopping stretch near Bruce Grove. It's an adult gaming centre, which means it's 18+ only.

On matchdays the whole road comes alive, with fans streaming up towards the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium further north, which also hosts NFL games and big concerts; expect crowds and road closures when there's an event on. For something quieter, Bruce Castle Museum, in a Tudor manor house on Lordship Lane, tells the story of Haringey and sits in a pleasant park. To the east, Tottenham Marshes and the Lee Valley open up into wide green space along the River Lea.
